messages.subject: How to scale parameters
parts:
Hello!

I am using brms to fit a Weibull growth model.

When I specify it as:

weibull.bf2 <- bf(
  height ~ Hmax - (Hmax - Hmin) * exp(-((k)*days)^delta), #Weibull model
  Hmax + k + delta ~ (1|ID),
  Hmin ~ 1, 
  nl=TRUE)

Then the parameter k ends up being very small and leads to sampling problems.

To put k on a more similar scale to the rest of the parameters I changed the model so that k was being divided by 100 in the formula:

weibull.bf3 <- bf(
  height ~ Hmax - (Hmax - Hmin) * exp(-((k/100)*days)^delta), #Weibull model
  Hmax + k + delta ~ (1|ID),
  Hmin ~ 1, 
  nl=TRUE)

This works well.  But is this best way to accomplish the scaling or should I be doing something else?

Thanks,

Julin
